mental_profile.notes: Coach Fabio Cannavaro publicly stated (Zamin.uz, 24 Sep 2026) that despite his youth Hakimov 'has shown no fear', and cited his positional literacy and composure as reasons for the call-up -- a rare, specific coach-quote data point on mentality for a player this young.

data_quality.notes: 16-year-old central defender for Bunyodkor, promoted from the academy to the first team only a few months before being called up to Uzbekistan's senior national team by head coach Fabio Cannavaro, per a Zamin.uz article dated 24 Sep 2026. Has played 7 matches in the Uzbekistan Super League to date. Set what the article describes as a record for the shortest gap between a professional debut and a senior national-team call-up in Uzbek football. ESPN lists him as 'Mukhammad Khakimov' (transliteration variant of 'Muhammad Hakimov') -- both spellings refer to the same Bunyodkor defender per matching club/position. Exact date of birth, height, foot, contract length and market value not found in snippets -> null. Age (16) is as explicitly stated in the source article as of Sept 2026.
